cooling_opportunity_note: Cooling opportunity represents evidence of an actionable public site or transit waiting area; no canopy, shade, or surface condition is inferred.
missing_strategy: Preserve missing raw/normalized values and renormalize each composite across only its available weighted inputs.
patronage_metric: For each stop, use the maximum published boardings plus alightings across retained DX, SA, and SU categories without assigning meanings to those day-code prefixes; then sum stops in a tile.
point_join_note: Points outside the returned heat-tile coverage by at most 25 meters are assigned to the nearest tile and explicitly flagged as proximity joins; farther points remain unmatched.
population_context_note: ACS total population is an area-weighted intersecting-tract context estimate; it is not apportioned to or claimed as a tile population.
